title: The Mistress of Puppets
description:
You want to have your mind controlled until your body follows. To be hypnotized to become a puppet for me, held by my silken strings. You want me to take control of your open mind, and twist it into shape… any shape I want.

And you don’t care how I do it, do you? Just being hypnotized and losing control is enough. Just being taken over like that, body and mind is so sexy, so deeply arousing, that however I appear, however I convince you, you don’t really mind. You just want to feel it.

Because I’m your Mistress. The Mistress of Puppets. And you’ll become a puppet… for a puppet!
